dialogue.intro: There is no appointed road here. A tool, a shelter, a strange horizon: choose what makes you curious.
dialogue.progress: Gather wood and make your first tools.
dialogue.complete: Your first workshop is a promise that tomorrow can be different.

dialogue.intro: Craft a stone pickaxe to mine iron and other ores.
dialogue.progress: Use cobblestone to craft a stone pickaxe.
dialogue.complete: Less time fighting the stone; more time deciding what to build.

dialogue.intro: Build a doorway and step through when you are ready. Pack supplies; this chapter has no prescribed route.
dialogue.progress: Bring food, blocks and a way to relight your portal.
dialogue.complete: The world has become stranger, and larger.

dialogue.intro: Plant a seed. The smallest investment in a place can make it worth returning to.
dialogue.progress: Till soil near water, then plant your seeds.
dialogue.complete: A living world grows in the spaces between your adventures.

dialogue.intro: Mine stone with a pickaxe and collect the cobblestone.
dialogue.complete: Keep some cobblestone for a furnace and better tools. Claim a small field ration before your next trip.

dialogue.intro: Smelt raw iron in a furnace to obtain your first iron ingot.
dialogue.complete: The first ingot catches the firelight. Tools, a bucket, a new direction: the metal promises none of them, but permits all of them.
